adb.description: Launch BioShot app using ADB on any connected device

androidStudio.tip: Use Android Studio's Run 'BioShot' button or navigate to Run > Run 'BioShot'

requirements: Connected Android device via USB or emulator running

notes: The main activity may vary. Check AndroidManifest.xml for the exact launchable activity. If the adb command fails, try running 'adb shell pm list activities com.fkurevija.bioshot' to list all exportable activities.
